claims.summary: For a fixed rank-k binary k-by-n matrix R, 1<=k<n, and uniform U in GL_n(F2), write RU=[M C], W=det M, X=adj(M)C and V=U(I+N_X), with N_X in the upper-right rectangle. Pr(W=1)=product_(i<k)(1-2^(i-k))/product_(i<k)(1-2^(i-n)). Conditional on W=1, V is uniform on the invertible matrices with RV=[M_V 0], M_V invertible, and each has exactly 2^(k(n-k)) preimages. For rank R<k no frame succeeds. Consequently summing W f(AV,V^-1 B) over all U in F2 gives zero pointwise for every binary function f. This is an ambient-point law, not a probability distribution on an inconsistent PC quotient; no low-degree Boolean certificate is claimed for the parity identity.

claims.summary: Over F2 for Boolean matrices A:m by n and B:n by m, m>n, choose k outer rows, 1<=k<n. For k-subsets S of inner indices set p_S=det(A_R,S)det(B_S,R) and let sigma_S be the rectangular adjugate gauge on those pivot columns, relabeled back to the original coordinates. Then sum p_S=det((AB)_R,R), with sum p_S-1 having a rank-axiom certificate through 2k. The linear operator Lambda(f)=sum p_S sigma_S(f) is unital modulo the old rank base and has degree at most 2k+(k+1)deg f. It need not preserve products even in the proper old PC quotient: for k=1, R={1}, f=A_11, g=A_12, D>=8, n>=2D, m>n, Lambda(fg)-Lambda(f)Lambda(g) is outside C_D(Gamma_m,n). An affine identity-frame embedding with first row of A and first column of B equal to (1,1,1,0,...,0) maps the defect to one and the old base to Gamma_(m-1,n-1). This excludes using that linear gluing as a multiplicative source substitution, not every proof-specific or action-aware use.
